GEV sits second-lowest in the entire 18-name sample. FIRST CHECK: FQ3 2026.
signals.evidence: Current gross margins are 20.57% and revenue growth is 21.9% YoY. This indicates that gross margins are below the 25% threshold while revenue growth is above 15%, suggesting demand is not being fully captured as margin, aligning with the falsification condition.
